name: oc-time-report
description: Estimation-vs-logged-hours report over a period (independent of the AI-usage JSON). Tempo-worklog driven, TICKET-based: one row per ticket owned by its main developer (most total hours), with ticket type, area, title, Architect & Dev-lead estimates, total development time (logged + bug hours) plus the logged & bug hours separately (all contributors, subtasks rolled up), two time gains (Architect and Dev-lead, each without/with bugs; a gain shows as '-' when it is meaningless: a placeholder estimate <=0.5h, no logged time, or a magnitude beyond +/-1000%), an AI-assistance flag (ticket or any rolled-up sub-issue carries the AI-metrics field; aggregates show AI-assisted/total), the Jira status and a Final flag (terminal status for the ticket type: Bug=Done/Invalid, US=Ready for Sprint review/Need documentation/Ready for release/Released, others=Done), child-bug count, and a contributor breakdown. A ticket counts once, under its main developer. Prints Markdown and writes a self-contained styled, date-stamped HTML file and a CSV to ./docs/, plus a second report — a finished-User-Story per-developer summary (HTML + CSV, two tables split by AI true/false: avg bugs per US, sum architect estimate, sum logged/bug/total hours, gains without/with bugs, ending in a Total row whose avg bugs is total-bugs/total-US weighted by ticket count). Reads Jira (Atlassian MCP) + Tempo (TEMPO_API_TOKEN).
